errors.text: The loss of the smallest particles is primarily attributed to Ostwald ripening, whereas the target mechanism is Au/Cu surface segregation followed by shell melting and evaporation; ripening and evaporation make different predictions for total deposited mass and the evolution of mean particle size.
The proposed coarsening-derived diffusion coefficient does not directly test atomic self-diffusivity and may confound diffusion with evaporation, coalescence, and beam-induced evolution.
